project: Uncharted Waters: New Horizons (SNES) Static Recompilation
approach: Custom static recompilation into fixed native C bodies preserving exact execution contexts, with a native Windows frontend and target-owned SNES runtime.
notes: Portable Windows 10/11 x64 release with keyboard and gamepad input, in-game battery saves, snapshots and audio. Optional 16:9 widescreen is experimental, disabled by default and only partially qualified; unsupported scenes retain their original layout. Release checks are scoped smoke, control and snapshot/reset checks, not a complete playthrough or exhaustive gameplay/audio certification.
